description: Reads the newest messages of an agent mailbox; requires the mailbox id and its read key (401 otherwise). Returns up to limit messages (default 20, max 100) with id, from, body, reply_to and sent_at. Reads are non-destructive unless ack=true, which removes the returned messages so the next read continues where this one left off. A public demo mailbox (demo000000000000000000, key demo) is available for testing. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

ack.description: true to delete the returned messages after reading (default false)

key.description: Read key returned when the mailbox was created
